reason: SpecFlow is primarily a planning and execution workflow plugin that turns ideas into reviewable specifications, implementation plans, task lists, and resumable DeepSeek Harness goals stored in workspace files.

summaries.zh: SpecFlow 将想法整理为可审阅的规范、实施计划和任务清单，并支持在 DeepSeek Harness 会话之间保存进度和恢复执行。
summaries.en: SpecFlow turns ideas into reviewable specifications, implementation plans, and task lists while preserving progress for resumable DeepSeek Harness workflows.

capabilities: Provides specification, planning, task-list, and implementation workflow commands
Creates and resumes durable DeepSeek Harness goals
Reads task progress from workspace Markdown files
May ask the agent to create or update files under .dsh/memory/ and .dsh/specs/
Can inject active goal and task progress into model-visible runtime context
